notes:
- Account screen with a financial overview: balance and 7-month trend, account statement, open documents, monthly chart, collection, risk, turnover and volume ratios, aging and recent records, per currency
- Working past midnight: while only yesterday is open, new entries are dated yesterday (with yesterday's exchange rate) until you close the day; with older open days you can save drafts and close all open days in one step after reviewing them
- Error messages appear as notifications with the field name; the field with an error is outlined in red
- Amounts get thousands separators while you type
- Account names in the chart of accounts and financial reports appear in your language
- Chart of accounts is the first tab under Financial statements; the trial balance no longer lists two-digit class groups; journal, general ledger and subsidiary ledger show entry numbers and voucher types
- Print opens a preview with page headers and numbers; wide reports print in landscape
- Change log: who changed what and when, with a "What changed" summary; each account and entry shows its history
- Assets: the button is now "Opening asset entry"; new purchases are entered from the expense or payable accrual form; assets can be corrected or cancelled; opening assets are locked after the first day is closed
- Transfers can buy or sell foreign currency and gold between payment types
- Lending, loans, advances and capital movements are no longer counted as income or expense
- Payment sub-types get their own account under their parent's account
- Unused categories, payment types and transaction types can be deleted
- Referrals are chosen from the account list
- Due templates can fall on a fixed day of the month, with more ready-made templates
- Transfer packages are also protected by the owner's user name and main password
- Feedback can include up to 3 images or a screenshot
- The DEMO label shows its explanation from the (i) next to it; Business activity has an explanation of what it adds
- The permission template name stays visible and changes to "Custom" when you change a permission
- Daily cash book is in the Reports menu
- Fixed: an error report could be sent when the screen locked
- Stronger protection of local settings and files
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
